N_star: smallest N on the grid 2^(j/2), j = 0..59 (rounded), with failure rate <= 0.25 at that N and at the next grid point; 200 replications per point
calibration: sigma, sigma_f and the spacing grids were chosen on i.i.d. Gaussian noise only (price slopes -5.96 for K = 2 and -9.96 for K = 3; tagged N* between 256 and 724), before any real noise was downloaded; the code was dry-run on synthetic Student-t noise

economy.rule: K-point Gauss-Legendre nodes s and normalized weights; rates rc + d_eta*s, merged weights W*omega

estimators.price_only: closed-loop deconvolution of h_1..h_2K into kernel values, then Prony (Hankel solve, real roots in (0,1), Vandermonde weights)
estimators.tagged: per class, least squares of fbar_t on (fbar_{t-1}, hbar_t), t = 1..5 (6 taps)

experiment: each reset experiment returns the unit-impulse price response h_0..h_{T-1} plus sigma times a noise window (h_0 = kappa known); with tagging it also returns each class's flow response plus sigma_f times independent noise windows
failure: any weight off by more than 0.25 times the smallest true weight, or no valid Prony solution

hypotheses.H1_primary: price-only, K = 2, real noise: OLS slope of log N* on log d_eta lies in [-7.5, -4.5] (theory -6)
hypotheses.H2_primary: tagged, K = 2, real noise: N* stays bounded across the spacing grid, max/min of N*_tagged <= 8 (theory: bounded above and below uniformly in d_eta; the price-only requirement grows by about (0.5/0.125)^6 = 4096 over the same grid); the slope is reported but is not the criterion, because over a finite grid a bounded requirement can drift mildly
hypotheses.H3_secondary: price-only, K = 3, real noise: slope lies in [-12.5, -7.5] (theory -10)
hypotheses.H4_report: ratio N*_real / N*_gaussian at each spacing (no criterion)

noise_arms.large_N: averages of N windows are resampled exactly for N <= 4096 and drawn as Gaussian vectors with the pool's empirical window covariance for N > 4096 (central limit theorem); the share of N* values in each regime is reported
noise_arms.real: Binance spot BTCUSDT one-minute klines on the 6th of each month, January 2025 to September 2026 (21 days, untouched in this project); log close-to-close changes; non-overlapping windows of length T within each day; demeaned and scaled to unit variance over the pool

noise_levels.note: real windows are standardized to unit variance; the test is about the shape of the noise, not its level

pass_rule: the test passes if H1 and H2 both hold; H3 and H4 are reported either way
question: Does the price-only sample requirement still scale as (Delta eta)^-(4K-2), and does the class-tagged requirement stay flat, when the observation errors of the reset experiments have the shape of real market price changes (heavy tails, autocorrelation, volatility clustering) rather than i.i.d. Gaussian noise?
relation: Paper 1 Theorems thm:kcohort, prop:esprit and thm:discvalue; answers the referees' request for validation under real noise. Synthetic cohorts with known spacing; only the noise is real.
runs: run once; every run is counted in the unlock file
